verified.exploit_entry_point: The library's public API: postcss.parse(css, opts) and postcss(plugins).process(css, opts). Only the advisory's own route is covered by the security cases (4 cases).
sites: lib/previous-map.js:86-92 (loadFile reads whatever path it is given, with no confinement)
lib/previous-map.js:124-127 (the annotation branch joins the stylesheet folder and hands the result to loadFile)
routes: T1: an annotation naming an absolute path with no stylesheet file, or a traversal path relative to the stylesheet, reads a file outside the stylesheet's folder
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own map and previous-map suites with the project's native runner (uvu + ts-node, transpile-only), plus 12 functional cases and 4 control security cases, on the pinned tree and the control reference fix.

traps.shape: a source-map annotation names an absolute path (no stylesheet file) or a traversal path relative to the stylesheet, so the processor reads a local file outside the stylesheet's folder
traps.reason_to_dismiss: loading the previous map named by the annotation is the documented feature, and the caller can turn it off
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, completed by GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp) at the pinned commit
